Insurance

Requisito de Capital

The minimum amount of capital an insurer must hold to meet regulatory standards and ensure solvency against policyholder risks, calculated per statutory formulae (e.g., Solvency II, RBC).

Quick answer: The minimum amount of capital an insurer must hold to meet regulatory standards and ensure solvency against policyholder risks, calculated per statutory formulae (e.g., Solvency II, RBC).

What is Requisito de Capital?

In this glossary, Requisito de Capital refers to: The minimum amount of capital an insurer must hold to meet regulatory standards and ensure solvency against policyholder risks, calculated per statutory formulae (e.g., Solvency II, RBC).

How is Requisito de Capital used in finance?

In finance communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "El incumplimiento del requisito de capital puede dar lugar a la intervención regulatoria o a la retirada de la licencia."
